note: Structural items that cannot be compared statically, registered explicitly (owner + reviewBy + reason). An entry here is a decision, not debt: the checker prints it as `registered` and it is not a divergence. An entry that matches no observed item is an error (delete it), and a past reviewBy is an error (re-review it). Shapes: (a) an untitled baseline group whose only row text is runtime data (error/notice blocks), so no literal criterion exists by design; (b) other items a human has judged not statically comparable. An Android title or label made only of host data (no literal wording, UiStrings, CONST, native() or .format) is no longer registered here: page_structure_check.is_data_label classifies it, mirroring the contract's unlabelled actions and expression-titled sections, and prints it under `data-labelled Android items` (spec/ui/v1/page-structure-rules.md).

entries.name: 删除
entries.reason: DailyBriefPage.swift:112 is a `.swipeActions` Label("删除"); Android renders the same action as a SwipeToDismissBox background label, and DailyBriefPageTest states that turning it into a visible button must fail on purpose. The action exists on both sides; only the affordance differs.

entries.name: <manual region>

entries.name: <untitled: row(capability)>
entries.reason: PhonePermissionsPage.swift:74 iterates `PhoneCapability.allCases`; each row's label is the capability's own title, which is data from the model, not a literal in the view.

entries.name: <untitled: empty>
entries.reason: PDSHShellPage.swift:74 is an untitled Section whose only row (PDSHShellPage.swift:75) is a ternary button (运行/运行中…); the literal the extractor reads exists in only one branch, so no stable row criterion exists. The section is the run/stop action block, judged through its actions.

entries.name: <untitled: empty>
entries.reason: The first RuntimeDetailsPage Section (ChatPage.swift:4330) opens with `runtimeRow("状态", model.isStarted ? statusValue : "已停止")`; the label's value is a ternary, so no stable first-row criterion exists. The row and the stop/restart action are judged by the actions, not by this group title.

notes.text: `完全权限` 是 Swift 的字符串比较操作数（ChatPage.swift:1401 `AccessModeWording.title(…) == "完全权限"`），不是 section 标题；该组的真实标题是两个三元分支之一，rows 就是 :1376 的菜单按钮、已作为 action 覆盖。契约里该 section 被标 `suppressed`，不给 Android 加假字面量 section。
